title: Localization gives the unique rational transition with the prescribed tensor formula.
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, an arbitrary scheme $X$, and finite intermediate fields $\mathbf Q_\ell\subseteq E\subseteq F\subseteq\Omega$ (equality allowed). Work in $\mathcal C=\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathbf{Ab})$ on the small site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with the sheafified tensor $\otimes=\otimes_{\mathbf Z}$ [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor]. For $G=E,F$, write $A_G=p_X^*\underline{\mathcal O_G}$ and $K_G=p_X^*\underline G$, with their canonical inclusion $i_G:A_G\to K_G$, using the continuous-function condensed rings and their pulled-back ring objects [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. For $n\geq1$ put $B_{G,n}=p_X^*\underline{\mathcal O_G/\ell^n\mathcal O_G}$, with discrete quotient topology, and let $r_{G,n}:A_G\to B_{G,n}$ be reduction. Put
$$T_{G,n}=B_{G,n}\otimes\mu_{\ell^n,X},\qquad M_G=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}T_{G,n}.$$
Here the roots and their power transitions are those of [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf]; $T_{G,n}$ is an $A_G$-module with action on its first factor through $r_{G,n}$, the tower transition is the $A_G$-module map with underlying arrow quotient reduction tensored with $z\mapsto z^\ell$ [lem-sp-integral-level-transition-unique], the limit is taken in internal $A_G$-modules, and its action and underlying projections $p_{G,n}$ are coordinatewise [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence, def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Thus $M_G$ is the actual integral twist, with the natural-number index $n-1$ of `spIntegralTwistLevel` corresponding to exponent $n$.

Let $d:K_E\to K_F$ be the pulled-back field inclusion and $j:A_E\to A_F$ the ring inclusion characterized by $i_Fj=di_E$ [lem-route-sp-integers-map-exists-unique]. Let $a_n:B_{E,n}\to B_{F,n}$ be the quotient transition characterized by $a_nr_{E,n}=r_{F,n}j$ [lem-route-sp-ell-map-exists-unique]. Let $u:M_E\to M_F$ be the integral transition characterized by
$$p_{F,n}u=(a_n\otimes1_{\mu_{\ell^n,X}})p_{E,n}\quad(n\geq1)$$
[lem-route-sp-integral-twist-map-exists-unique]. Define $Q_G=K_G\otimes_{A_G}M_G$ by extension of scalars [def-sfb-modobj-extension], with its defining balancing-coequalizer projection $q_G:K_G\otimes M_G\to Q_G$. Then there is exactly one morphism of abelian sheaves $f:Q_E\to Q_F$ such that
$$f\circ q_E=q_F\circ(d\otimes u).$$
This is the underlying-morphism assertion of `AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.spRationalTwistMap_existsUnique`: $Q_G$ is `spRationalTwist X ℓ G` and $q_G$ is `Mod.extendπ`. No invertibility of $\ell$ on $X$, local freeness, or additional linearity hypothesis on $f$ is imposed.

proof.text: The finite quotient transition j_n is a monoid-object morphism. Indeed its composite with the epimorphic coefficient reduction is the composite of the integral coefficient inclusion [lem-route-sp-integers-map-exists-unique] with the target coefficient reduction. The defining square [lem-route-sp-ell-map-exists-unique] therefore yields preservation of one by precomposition with the source unit, and preservation of multiplication by cancelling the tensor of the source reduction with itself. Tensoring preserves epimorphisms because the sheaf tensor is a left adjoint [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-tensor-closed].

proof.text: For each finite level the tensor of j_n and the root identity is semilinear: use the free-module action, the coefficient reduction square, associator naturality and preservation of multiplication by j_n. Apply the jointly monic underlying target limit projections [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit] to the desired integral action equation. Projection linearity and the finite normalization [lem-route-sp-integral-twist-map-exists-unique] reduce it to the finite-level semilinearity just proved.

proof.text: Write the source and target extension-of-scalars objects as their defining balancing coequalizers [def-sfb-modobj-extension]. Tensor the coefficient field inclusion with the integral transition and then compose with the target coequalizer projection. This arrow coequalizes the source balancing pair: the coefficient square from [lem-route-sp-integers-map-exists-unique], multiplicativity of the field inclusion, associator naturality, and the preceding integral semilinearity transform its first composite into its second. Hence Mod.extendDescHom supplies an arrow of the required type, and its factorization equation is exactly the requested normalization. The source coequalizer projection is epi [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], so cancelling it gives uniqueness.

theorem spRationalTwistMap_existsUnique {E F : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ}
    (h : E ≤ F) :
    ∃! f : (spRationalTwist X ℓ E).X ⟶ (spRationalTwist X ℓ F).X,
      Mod.extendπ (padicIntegersToPadicSubfield X ℓ E) (spIntegralTwist X ℓ E) ≫ f =
        (coefficientMap.{u} (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjMap ℓ h) X ⊗ₘ
          spIntegralTwistMap X ℓ h) ≫
            Mod.extendπ (padicIntegersToPadicSubfield X ℓ F) (spIntegralTwist X ℓ F) := by
  sorry
